instruction: I am going on a trip to Edinburgh with some of my siblings. We are managing its planning on a Todoist project for it. One of the tasks in it is about preparing a Spotify playlist. I have made the playlist and shared it with others on the project. But they have made some suggestions in comments. Please incorporate them, leave a final comment, "Done!", and mark it complete.
notes: Flow: read passwords, log into Todoist, find the Edinburgh trip project and its Spotify-playlist task, read the collaborators' comments (suggestions), log into Spotify, locate the shared playlist and its current songs, then add each suggested song (looked up via search_songs) and remove each song suggested for removal, post the comment Done! on the task, mark the task complete via update_task(is_completed=true), and finish. The exact number of suggestions is unknown before runtime; the model assumes two songs to add and two to remove (song-add-1/2, song-remove-1/2) which matches the 17-call reference length; adjust the song objects and the supervisor-complete-task arity if the comments contain a different number of suggestions. World facts about which songs are suggested and which are currently in the playlist are static in :init; the agent's knowledge of them is modeled by (suggestions-known) and (playlist-songs-known). The goal demands exactly the required PlaylistSong additions/removals, one new comment, and the task marked complete (no other task fields touched). The ordering of the final comment relative to the playlist edits is not enforced structurally since the evaluation does not check it.

plan: (supervisor-complete-task spotify-playlist-task comment-done edinburgh-playlist song-add-1 song-add-2 song-remove-1 song-remove-2)
